## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in London, United Kingdom. The listing gives its length as 1 hours, over a route of about 3.0 km. It starts at Tower Bridge, Tower Bridge Rd, London SE1 2UP, UK. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Tower Bridge. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> This self-guided audio tour is perfect for anyone interested in exploring the rich history, architectural marvels, and cultural significance of London. Your ticket to Tower Bridge is included, but please note that an audio tour inside Tower Bridge is not provided.
>
> The tour begins at the majestic Tower Bridge, an engineering masterpiece that has been a symbol of London since its completion in 1894. From here, you will make your way through several notable sites, including the historic Tower of London, Potters Fields Park, and the Royal Navy warship HMS Belfast. Your journey will culminate at The Shard, one of London's most modern and iconic landmarks.
>
> Along the way, you will discover the intricate history of the Tower of London, the innovative architecture of the Bridge Theatre, and the scenic views of Potters Fields Park. You will also learn about the military significance of HMS Belfast and the modern splendor of The Shard. This tour offers a unique blend of historical and modern experiences, providing a comprehensive glimpse into London's diverse cultural and architectural landscape.
>
> As you conclude your journey, you will have experienced some of London's most memorable landmarks and gained a deeper understanding of the city's complex history and vibrant cultural scene.
